Name: Custom Walls and Floors Depot
Author: minervamaga
AuthorLabel: Project Populate Custom Furniture Walls and Floors
TagLine: Various wallpaper and flooring mods converted to work with Custom Walls and Floors
Description:
DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD FROM ANYWHERE EXCEPT HERE, MODDROP, OR MY GITHUB
Other websites are stealing mods from Nexus and uploading them without permission, while earning money on each mod they steal.  My mods are always found on the three sites listed above and no where else.

Can't decide between two wallpaper packs and too lazy to combine them yourself?  Now, you don't have to!  Welcome to the home of PPCFWF's conversions for Custom Walls and Floors.  The other half of this project, the Custom Furniture packs, are hosted on [Froststar11's](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/52928861)﻿ page.  Please go check them out!

This mod requires [Custom Walls and Floors](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3010) to work.

Mods Hosted Here

*   [Cerri's Walls and Floors](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1456)﻿

*   [Missy's Pretty Little Pixels](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1579)﻿
Install

1.  [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io/).

2.  [Install PyTK](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726)﻿.

3.  [Install Custom Walls and Floors](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3010)﻿.

4.  Download this mod and unzip it, then copy  the '[CWF] Cerri's Walls and Floors' folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.

5.  You're done; run the game using SMAPI!
